overview_description.description: Sohar Health is an AI-driven company that offers front-end Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) solutions. The services focus on enhancing healthcare providers' insurance verification processes, aiming to improve efficiency and reduce claim denials. Sohar Health utilizes advanced technology to streamline eligibility checks and facilitate better pricing transparency. The platform caters primarily to the needs of sales teams and sales development representatives in the healthcare sector. By automating key processes, Sohar Health helps organizations optimize their revenue cycle operations.

about_short_description.short_description: Sohar Health automates insurance verification for behavioral health providers with EHR integration and real-time eligibility updates.

product.name: Verification
product.description: An API-driven service that performs real-time insurance eligibility checks with high accuracy and low latency to validate patient coverage and benefits.

product.name: Network Status
product.description: An API and portal solution that determines a patient’s insurance in-network or out-of-network status in real time to reduce claim denials and administrative overhead.

product.name: Discovery
product.description: An API service that identifies a patient’s active insurance coverage using minimal patient data such as name, date of birth, and state.

product.name: Patient Intake Solutions
product.description: A combined set of API-driven tools that streamline patient onboarding by integrating Discovery, Verification, and Network Status to improve eligibility determination and financial outcomes.

product.name: Reduction in Claims Denials
product.description: A service leveraging insurance verification and payer intelligence to identify carve-outs and correct member details, reducing front-end claim denials and administrative rework.
